mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20d returns when FEDFUNDS is below its 50th percentile are negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20d returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply shock regimes (as defined by INDPRO decline > 2% and oil price spike), 60d SPX returns are not negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals weak consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20d returns when PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile are negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), 60d SPX returns are not negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
